_readme: Accepted-measurement policies for AnonRouter's own confidential gateway (the
first of the two hops this SDK verifies). The second hop, the upstream model
provider's enclave, is pinned separately in measurements.json.
THIS FILE MUST NEVER BE FETCHED FROM THE GATEWAY IT DESCRIBES. A verifier that
downloads its allowlist from the server it is verifying can always be handed an
allowlist naming that server. It ships inside the published packages instead, and
the CI parity gate proves the JavaScript and Python copies never drift.
status=published  a released plane, resolved by verifyGateway() by default.
status=candidate  a reviewed but pre-release plane whose pins are expected to
move. Requires allowCandidate: true, so a default call can
never quietly pass against a plane that is not released.
Every switch in a policy is REQUIRED. A truncated or hand-edited policy fails to
parse rather than silently disabling a check.

policies.notes: AnonRouter confidential content plane running in an Intel TDX CVM (Large class). Published from the independently retained production release manifest with SHA-256 d992b00b085d9d500d88ff926dea5c9916d29c103fe127e61273d6bde084e2a5, which corresponds to operator policy generation 2026-09-09-content-plane-v1.0.19. That manifest binds reviewed monorepo source commit 3e4e9c818759b123a0cfd9a6f089c3a11769b1e1, the exact measured app compose 9329f5078f9ca6fe658ec999d92a3d5d7661b7d81f60d6410ac3377ce6090f02, the digest-pinned public content-plane image sha256:0e7e5625538b16303c7b759e8c924f043b4da1ebfc23416f5bebaea6bb717c0f from signed tag content-plane-v1.0.19 at public commit 997bf0c181e672f0111f4a78ecb27b336c387fbf, and eleven further digest-pinned images. The image has a keyless GitHub Actions signature, SLSA v1 provenance whose subject matches the digest, and an SPDX SBOM. Every pinned identity and platform value was re-observed on 2026-09-11 in two independent fresh nonce-bound quotes, one per origin, and each quote's leaf SPKI was separately observed on the wire for that hostname. Both observations match the independently retained manifest and production measurement policy; no value was accepted merely because the gateway reported it. api.private.anonrouter.ai remains an attested alias; api.anonrouter.ai is the customer default. The release id is not treated as sufficient identity: app id, compose hash and every platform measurement remain independently pinned, and mrConfigId independently re-states the compose hash in a register the guest cannot re-narrate. RTMR0 is the hardware-configuration register; this deployment did not resize and RTMR0 remained unchanged. It was not reproduced offline with dstack-mr, so it rests on agreeing independent quotes and the retained manifest rather than an offline recomputation. Two third-party source-to-digest provenance gaps named in the manifest (caddy-edge-base, node-base-image) remain supply-chain limitations, not attestation bypasses. requireHardwareVerified remains true, so verification fails closed unless a DCAP chain verifier is supplied.
